comment: ANCHOR: DESK_SWR_20261107 — LQ-20261107-201. Desk reads took 16-44 s warm against a 30 s browser limit,
so the pages showed 'unavailable'. Allowlisted desk GETs now serve the last good body at once (stamped _swr
with as_of and age) and refresh in the background, single-flight; a restart serves the persisted 0600 copy.
The CIO facts snapshot is memoised per InstrumentRecord store file and reloaded after any append.
